metadata.title: Selected Calgary property assessment history 2017–2026

sourceSchema.roll_number: text, leading zeros can be absent in actual API response

metadata.method: Query both canonical current roll strings and their leading-zero-stripped variants; map responses to original current roll keys. Verified historical 58586389 matches current 058586389 at the same 2061110 5 AV NW property. Query 2017–2025; append current 2026 values already retrieved. Deduplicate same annual values across parcel rows, never sum them. Conflicting annual values remain null with values listed.
limits: Assessed value is not sale price, equity, current market value or a historical tax bill.
Renovations, parcel changes and assessment revisions can affect comparability; missing years remain gaps.
The history dataset excludes titled parking stalls and storage units; these can be separate costs/titles.
